name: EPIC 214611660
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 7, 12.1 solar radii and 1.25 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_gal, EPIC 214611660 (K2 campaign 7): PARAM radius (solar radii) 12.101026 (16th-84th percentiles 11.349583-12.957755), MA09 pipeline with GALAH DR3

text.card: A red giant 3,584 parsecs away, 12 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 7, give 1.25 solar masses and 12.1 solar radii; GALAH spectra give 4,739 K at its surface.
